svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V2 · The Pixel World — The board
svg.desc: Cut along the pixel edge of the world: 314x314 mm, stepped outline 7 mm outside the rim squares, with an engraved border band. Rim squares carry double chevrons — the app's own wind-arrow glyph. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
